assertion_results.text: The plan determines feature-branch workflow mode (not direct-to-main) based on the atomicity constraints in the feature description
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md contains 'Selected mode: feature-branch' with rationale citing three atomicity indicators: (1) 'Coordinated schema migrations', (2) 'Tightly coupled feature components' quoting the feature's 'All changes must land together' constraint, and (3) 'Breaking API changes'. summary-comment.md confirms: 'Feature-branch — the workflow:feature-branch label will be applied to TC-9005. assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9005 has Priority: High. impact-map.md documents priority inheritance: '"priority": {"name": "High"}' in the additional_fields JSON block, and '**priority**: inherited from Feature TC-9005 (High)'. summary-comment.md confirms: '**Priority**: `High` — inherited from Feature TC-9005 and propagated to all created tasks via `additional_fields.priority`.'

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9005 has Fix Versions: RHTPA 2.0.0. No fixVersion scope config exists in CLAUDE.md, defaulting to 'both'. impact-map.md documents: '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 2.0.0"}]' in additional_fields, and '**fixVersions**: inherited from Feature TC-9005 (RHTPA 2.0.0); fixVersion scope not set in Jira Field Defaults, defaulting to "both" (propagate to tasks)'. summary-comment.md confirms: '**Fix Versions**: `RHTPA 2.0.0` — inherited from Feature TC-9005 and propagated to all created tasks via `additional_fields.fixVersions`. The fixVersion scope setting is not configured in CLAUDE.md Jira Field Defaults, so the default of "both" applies (propagate to tasks).'

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists in the outputs directory and contains an 'Inherited Field Values' section with: '**Priority**: `High` — inherited from Feature TC-9005 and propagated to all created tasks via `additional_fields.priority`.' and '**Fix Versions**: `RHTPA 2.0.0` — inherited from Feature TC-9005 and propagated to all created tasks via `additional_fields.fixVersions`.' The impact-map.md also contains the same information in its 'Additional Fields for Created Issues' section.
